title: have to：问句、否定句与过去式
description: 先看时间和主语，再决定 do / does / did 与 have 的形式；28 题可分项练，也可混合练。

skills.base: do / does / did 后用原形

questions.prompt:
Yesterday the last bus had already left, so we ___ walk home.
只填写空缺的两个词。
questions.hint: 找 Yesterday：过去“不得不”用什么？
answers: had to
questions.explanation: Yesterday 和 had already left 都在说过去，当时不得不走回家，用 had to。

questions.prompt:
改正时态错误，写出完整句子：
The museum was free last Sunday, so we don't have to buy tickets.
questions.hint: was 和 last Sunday 指过去；过去“不需要”用 didn’t have to。
answers: The museum was free last Sunday, so we didn't have to buy tickets.
questions.explanation: 过去那天不需要买票，用 didn’t have to；didn’t 后用 have。

questions.prompt:
把这句话改成过去发生的事，并把 every morning 换成 yesterday morning：
We have to leave early every morning.
questions.hint: 只改变时间：have to → had to。
answers: We had to leave early yesterday morning.
questions.explanation: yesterday morning 说过去，have to 变为 had to。

questions.prompt:
Where did she ___ to wait for the school bus?
只填写空缺的一个词。
questions.hint: did 后面用 have，不用 had 或 has。
answers: have
questions.explanation: did 已经表示过去，后面用动词原形 have。

questions.prompt:
改正动词形式，写出完整问句：
How much did he had to pay for the train ticket?
questions.hint: 保留 did，把后面表示过去的 had 变回原形。
answers: How much did he have to pay for the train ticket?
questions.explanation: did 和 had 不一起表示过去；改成 did he have to pay。

questions.prompt:
对 at seven 提问，保留 Mia，不用代词：
Mia had to get up at seven.
questions.hint: 问几点用 What time，过去问句用 did，后面把 had 改成 have。
answers: What time did Mia have to get up?
When did Mia have to get up?
questions.explanation: 顺序是 What time + did + Mia + have to get up。

questions.prompt:
根据下面的陈述句，询问他什么时候必须离开；用 he 代替 Paul：
Paul has to leave soon.
questions.hint: Paul 换成 he，仍然问他；用 What time does he…?
answers: What time does he have to leave?
When does he have to leave?
questions.explanation: Paul → he，问的是同一个人，所以用 does he，不能改成 do you。

questions.prompt:
对 at the sports centre 提问，用 she 代替 Anna：
Anna has to meet her coach at the sports centre.
questions.hint: 问地点用 Where；Anna → she，后面用 does she have to。
answers: Where does she have to meet her coach?
questions.explanation: Anna → she，her coach 保留；问句仍在问 Anna，不是问你。

questions.prompt:
对 a poster 提问，用 they 代替 the children：
The children have to make a poster.
questions.hint: the children 是不止一个人，用 they；问物品用 What。
answers: What do they have to make?
questions.explanation: the children → they，所以用 do they have to make。

questions.prompt:
I ___ have to wear a uniform at the weekend.
只填写 don't 或 doesn't。
questions.hint: 主语 I 和 don’t 搭配。
answers: don't
questions.explanation: I 用 don’t，不用 doesn’t。

questions.prompt:
只改正助动词，写出完整句子：
We doesn't have to finish the project today.
questions.hint: 主语是 we，应该选 don’t 还是 doesn’t？
answers: We don't have to finish the project today.
questions.explanation: We 用 don’t；后面的 have to finish 不变。

questions.prompt:
My sister ___ have to take the bus because she lives near school.
只填写 don't 或 doesn't。
questions.hint: My sister 可以换成 she。
answers: doesn't
questions.explanation: My sister 是一个人，相当于 she，用 doesn’t have to。

questions.prompt:
Last night, the campsite was full, so we ___ find another place to stay.
只填写空缺的两个词。
questions.hint: Last night 是过去，当时“不得不”用 had to。
answers: had to
questions.explanation: Last night 指过去：had to find another place。

questions.prompt:
改正动词形式，写出完整问句：
Where does she has to put her school bag?
questions.hint: does 后面用原形 have。
answers: Where does she have to put her school bag?
questions.explanation: does 后用 have，不能再用 has。

questions.prompt:
对 because of the rain 提问，用 he 代替 Ben：
Ben had to stay inside because of the rain.
questions.hint: 问原因用 Why；Ben → he，过去用 did。
answers: Why did he have to stay inside?
questions.explanation: Ben → he，问原因时写 Why did he have to stay inside?

questions.prompt:
They ___ have to bring lunch because the school provides it.
只填写 don't 或 doesn't。
questions.hint: They 和 don’t 搭配。
answers: don't
questions.explanation: They 用 don’t，后面的 have to bring 不变。

questions.prompt:
改正时态错误，写出完整句子：
I lost my key yesterday, so I have to wait outside.
questions.hint: lost 和 yesterday 表示过去，当时“不得不”要用 had to。
answers: I lost my key yesterday, so I had to wait outside.
questions.explanation: 两件事都发生在昨天：lost my key，所以 had to wait。

questions.prompt:
对 five pounds 提问，保留 they：
They had to pay five pounds for the boat ride.
questions.hint: 问多少钱用 How much；过去用 did，had 变回 have。
answers: How much did they have to pay for the boat ride?
questions.explanation: How much + did + they + have to pay。

questions.prompt:
对 on Friday 提问，用 she 代替 Lucy：
Lucy has to return the library books on Friday.
questions.hint: 问哪一天可用 When；Lucy → she。
answers: When does she have to return the library books?
On which day does she have to return the library books?
What day does she have to return the library books?
questions.explanation: Lucy → she，用 does she have to；不能把她换成 you。

questions.prompt:
只改正助动词，写出完整句子：
He don't have to hurry because there is plenty of time.
questions.hint: He 和 doesn’t 搭配。
answers: He doesn't have to hurry because there is plenty of time.
questions.explanation: He 用 doesn’t；不要把 have 变成 has。

questions.prompt:
We visited the castle yesterday. Entry was free, so we ___ buy tickets.
只填写空缺的部分；可用缩写。
questions.hint: 过去“不需要”用 did not have to；空缺不包括后面的 buy。
answers: didn't have to
did not have to
questions.explanation: Entry was free 说明当时不需要买票，用 didn’t have to，而不是 mustn’t。

questions.prompt:
改正动词形式，写出完整问句：
Why did they had to cancel the football match?
questions.hint: did 已经表示过去，后面用 have。
answers: Why did they have to cancel the football match?
questions.explanation: Why + did + they + have to cancel，不能写 did they had。

questions.prompt:
对 before lunch 提问，用 they 代替 Sam and Leo：
Sam and Leo have to tidy the classroom before lunch.
questions.hint: 两个人换成 they，问时间用 When do they…?
answers: When do they have to tidy the classroom?
questions.explanation: Sam and Leo → they，have to 的问句用 do they have to。

questions.prompt:
The two boys ___ have to share a desk because there are enough desks.
只填写 don't 或 doesn't。
questions.hint: The two boys 可以换成 they。
answers: don't
questions.explanation: 两个男孩是不止一个人，相当于 they，用 don’t。

questions.prompt:
把这句话改成过去发生的事，并把 today 换成 yesterday：
We do not have to bring our own lunch today.
questions.hint: 过去“不需要”用 did not have to。
answers: We did not have to bring our own lunch yesterday.
We didn't have to bring our own lunch yesterday.
questions.explanation: do not → did not，have 保持原形；today 换成 yesterday。

questions.prompt:
对 at the library 提问，保留 he：
He had to study at the library.
questions.hint: 问地点用 Where，过去用 did，had 变回 have。
answers: Where did he have to study?
questions.explanation: Where + did + he + have to study。

questions.prompt:
对 twenty minutes 提问，用 he 代替 Jack：
Jack had to wait twenty minutes for the bus.
questions.hint: 问多长时间用 How long；Jack → he，过去用 did。
answers: How long did he have to wait for the bus?
questions.explanation: Jack → he，问的是他等了多久：How long did he have to wait for the bus?

questions.prompt:
把这句话改成否定句，保留 I：
I have to stay at school after the lesson.
questions.hint: I 用 don’t，后面保留 have to stay。
answers: I don't have to stay at school after the lesson.
I do not have to stay at school after the lesson.
questions.explanation: I don’t have to 表示“我不需要”，不是“禁止我”。
